task.name: Infrastructure & Shell
task.action: Initialize index.html with: - Tailwind CSS and Lucide Icons via CDN. - Base CSS for "Linear.app" aesthetic (dark background #09090b, glassy borders, inter font). - Main Layout: Desktop area (relative), Taskbar (absolute bottom), and App Grid overlay. - Placeholder for System Health in the taskbar.
task.done: Base HTML structure and aesthetic foundation are ready.

task.name: State & Persistence Engine
task.action: Implement `ZenFlowState` class: - Use JS Proxies to detect changes in a central `state` object. - Implement `StorageManager` to sync the state to LocalStorage on every change (debounced). - Structure initial state: { tasks: [], notes: "", config: { theme: 'dark' }, windows: [] }.
task.verify: echo "Check console for 'State Synced' logs after programmatic update"
task.done: Reactive state and persistence layer are active.

task.name: Window Manager System
task.action: Implement `WindowManager` and `Window` classes: - Handle window creation, dragging (pointer events), resizing, and closing. - Implement z-index management (bring-to-front on click). - Add standard window chrome (title bar, close button, minimize). - Persist window positions/sizes in the state.
task.verify: echo "Visual check: can drag a test window across the desktop"

task.name: Kanban Task Manager
task.action: Implement `TaskManager` component: - 3 Columns: To-Do, In Progress, Done. - Add task functionality (title, description). - Native Drag-and-Drop simulation using `dragstart`, `dragover`, and `drop` events. - Update central state and trigger re-render on drop.
task.verify: echo "Verify task moves from 'To-Do' to 'Done' and persists on refresh"

task.name: Visual Pomodoro Timer
task.action: Implement `PomodoroApp` component: - Circular SVG progress bar that fills/empties based on time. - Controls: Play, Pause, Reset, Skip. - Settings for Focus/Short Break/Long Break durations. - Audio Notification: Use `AudioContext` to synthesize a 'Zen' chime when time is up.
task.verify: echo "Verify SVG circle updates as timer counts down"
task.done: Pomodoro timer with visual feedback and audio alerts.

task.name: Smart Notes (Markdown-lite)
task.action: Implement `NotesApp` component: - Textarea-based editor with auto-save on input. - Simple regex-based markdown preview (Headers, Bold, Lists). - Split view or toggle between Edit/Preview modes. - Content stored in `state.notes`.
task.verify: echo "Verify typing in notes updates LocalStorage immediately"

task.name: Command Palette & System Health
task.action: - Implement `CommandPalette` (Ctrl+K): Overlay search bar to launch apps or toggle settings. - Implement `SystemHealth`: Bottom-right widget showing: - Real-time Clock (HH:MM:SS). - Mock CPU/RAM usage (fluctuating values using `Math.random()`). - Register global keyboard shortcuts.
task.verify: echo "Verify Ctrl+K brings up the command menu"
task.done: OS navigation and status monitoring are complete.

task.name: Data Export & UI Polish
task.action: - Implement "Export Workspace": Download a `zenflow-backup.json` file containing the full state. - UI Polish: Add transitions, hover effects, and ensure Lucide icons are used consistently. - Dark/Light mode toggle via Command Palette.
task.verify: echo "Verify JSON export contains all tasks and notes"
task.done: ZenFlow OS is polished and data-portable.
